items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: At the time, I was working with this band in the war with Winslow Allen.

ctx.x: He lived up there. I knew Dink very well when he had a place up by the ballpark, you know. That's right. Yeah, by the ballpark.

I made some records with him. Yeah, yeah. But I just, just gigs we called. Yeah. No, I never played. All the work, most I played out here with, was between Mutt and Ory. Well, practically Ory. At the time, I was working with this band in the war with Winslow Allen. Over the place they call it Strip City now. Peacorn Western. We were working at nightclub. That's why I got drafted in Army again.

I was going to ask a little bit about Mutt, since Mutt, Kerry, isn't here anymore. He did a talk for himself. In the first place, I was wondering about how old Mutt was. Do you think he was as old as Ory? Ory thought he was about the same age, maybe.
